title: Exponential Bit-Complexity Tightening, Optimal b-ary Matching Trees, and Exact Sharp Support Thresholds for Normal-Form Correlated Equilibria in Extensive-Form Games
abstract: We establish three sharp structural, complexity-theoretic, and combinatorial advances over the recent PPAD-completeness proof for exact Normal-Form Correlated Equilibria (NFCE) in perfect-recall extensive-form games by Cheval, Horn, Paul, and Shirmohammadi (arXiv:2611.34897v1). First (Theorem 1), by exploiting active-support sparsity (eliminating zero-weight columns at optimal vertices), keeping the probability-simplex row unscaled, and replacing the raw payoff/chance denominator product B with per-player leaf-payoff least common multiples D_i, we sharpen the uniform rational LP reweighting gap of Lemma 14 from ((K+1)B)^{-(K+1)} to (sqrt(K) (K+1)^{K/2} D_max^K)^{-1}. This saves more than (K/2) log_2(K+1) + K log_2(B/D_max) bits of oracle precision (yielding >30x bit reduction on the authors' matching-tree instances at r=8, q=10), while proving exact two-player support dominance K - kappa_d = d_1^2 + d_2^2 - d_1 d_2 >= (d_1^2 + d_2^2)/2 (a 2x balanced reduction). Second (Theorem 2), generalizing the binary matching branch to arbitrary b-ary perfect-recall trees M_b(k) (m = b^k) shows that sequence-form dimensions d_1 = d_2 = m + r - 2 are invariant of b while node overhead f(b) = b + 2 + 2/(b-1) = 6 + (b-2)(b-3)/(b-1) achieves its unique integer minimum f(b) = 6 if and only if b in {2, 3}. This proves that the 1/36 node-quadratic constant of Corollary 20 is sharp across all b-ary matching trees, and that ternary trees (b=3) match the optimal node count 6m + r^2 + r - 3 while exponentially shrinking the pure-strategy space from r 2^{m-1} to r 3^{(m-1)/2} (over 10^{15}x smaller at m=243). Third (Theorem 3), we sharpen the PPAD-hardness matching-tree sizes by >=8x in the dimension-based reduction (m > r^2(r-1) vs 8r^3) and 32x-64x in the node-based reduction (m > r^2(r^2+r-3)/6 vs 8r^4), integrate the Kullback-Csiszar-Kemperman refined Pinsker bound, and prove an exact minimum-support dichotomy: an exact NFCE of support m^2 exists on Gamma_b(P,Q,k) if and only if (P,Q) admits an exact Nash equilibrium with probabilities in (1/m) Z, yielding a constructive ternary-vs-binary separation on an asymmetric 2x2 game with unique Nash equilibrium (2/3,1/3) x (1/3,2/3). All algebraic and combinatorial cores are formalized constructively in zero-dependency Lean 4.35.0 (18 theorems, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice) and verified by an AST-audited zero-float Python verifier issuing 16 SHA-256 certificates.
